prediction.confidence_reason: Outcome-blind deps.dev package-history preflight passed all three windows with 59/51/51 eligible issuer-weeks, 12 tickers per window, and top-1 shares below 24%. Immutable Maven publication events can precede developer adoption and cloud demand, but the nearby Hacker News developer-attention sleeve failed and release bursts may reflect maintenance rather than demand, so success probability is deliberately low.

calibration.surprise_note: The new source was broad and reproducible; the sleeve made modest standalone PnL in old_thin and mid_weak, but did not pay for displaced core capital and then lost outright in late_strong.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The hash-bound source and exact mapping produced ample cross-window candidates, but release cadence did not pay for capital displacement. The standalone sleeve earned only $653.37 in old_thin and $1,359.07 in mid_weak, then lost $5,637.33 in late_strong; the 24/76 capital-neutral portfolio lost EV and PnL in every window, and positive PnL was 98.98% concentrated in the top five tickers.
